in_marathi.name: Arjuth
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Born of a warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjuth हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjuth is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'arj', which means 'warrior'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuth is the name of the great warrior Arjuna, who is a central character in the Mahabharata epic. Arjuth is considered a brave and noble name, symbolizing strength, courage, and wisdom.
